close_reason: Done by JMAP-06zp.1 (commit 22c81a3). JMAP_METADATA_URI constant + MetadataCapability struct shipped in jmap-metadata-types. The bead description's premise ("register in jmap-server Session") is stale — Session lives in jmap-base-client, capabilities is HashMap<String,Value>, and extension capabilities are not registered as typed Session fields per workspace pattern. See bead comment for full rationale.
description:
jmap-server owns the Session shape and the canonical capability registration pattern. Add the metadata capability URI:

- Constant: pub const JMAP_METADATA_URI: &str = 'urn:ietf:params:jmap:metadata';
- Capability declaration struct: MetadataCapability with fields dataTypes, metadataTypes, maxDepth, maySetPrivate.

This needs to land before jmap-metadata-server (which depends on the URI being registered) and before jmap-metadata-client (which uses the capability to gate methods).

Blocked-on: JMAP-06zp.1 (need the types from jmap-metadata-types).
title: Register urn:ietf:params:jmap:metadata capability in jmap-server Session
